data.acquisitionSummary: Current 7-Eleven Hong Kong retail listing shows CMHK 4G MySIM at a HK$38 standard price with 30 days of unlimited local data (first 60GB up to 42Mbps), 5,000 local minutes and 50 on-net SMS. This replaces the stale HK$33 acquisition baseline; direct overseas purchase for this exact product is not established.

keep.action: Current MySIM terms say recharge extends prepaid-SIM validity. A standing CMHK official refill guide documents HK$50-HK$199 = 180 days and HK$200+ = 365 days, and a 2024 exact 4G MySIM community retention report independently reproduces HK$50 for 180 days. The lowest documented keep path remains two HK$50 recharges per year (HK$100/year), but confirm the displayed post-refill expiry date because the exact denomination ladder is not restated in the 2026 MySIM package PDF.

data.chinaActivation: From 17 June 2026, CMHK states that all prepaid SIM cards cannot be activated in Mainland China; activation is allowed in Hong Kong or an applicable roaming destination other than Mainland China. The reviewed material does not separately prove a fully remote new-line 4G MySIM onboarding path outside Hong Kong.
data.kyc: Hong Kong prepaid SIM cards used for person-to-person communications require real-name registration before activation. OFCA says a user without HKID may use another valid identity document such as a valid travel document or passport, subject to the regulation and provider flow.
data.payment: MySIM recharge is available through MyLink and the CMHK website. The standing CMHK refill guide lists Visa, MasterCard, JCB, UnionPay, qualifying Alipay and Octopus online payment and a HK$50 online minimum; universal foreign-issued-card acceptance remains unverified.
data.roamingSms: Exact-route evidence is limited. A 2023 4G MySIM user reported receiving the CMHK account/status SMS while in Shenzhen with mobile data off. A separate 2024 MySIM 5G user reported OTP/e-banking SMS success in Japan and South Korea, but that is adjacent-product evidence rather than an exact 4G result. Current MySIM roaming documentation also warns that a data connection can trigger a HK$15 daily charge. No current exact-4G bank/app success rate is created.
data.tariffSummary: Current 4G MySIM retail baseline HK$38; lowest documented retention path remains HK$50/180 days (~HK$100/year) with current recharge-extension rules plus the standing official refill ladder; physical card is eligible for eSIM conversion; Mainland-China first activation is prohibited.
guideSteps: Buy the current 4G MySIM physical starter through a current Hong Kong retail channel and complete required real-name registration.
Do not attempt first activation in Mainland China. CMHK's current prepaid rule allows activation in Hong Kong or an applicable roaming destination other than Mainland China.
If eSIM is needed, 4G MySIM is officially eligible for physical-prepaid-to-eSIM exchange; do not assume the exact product has a direct new-line eSIM purchase path.
For low-cost retention, the documented path is HK$50 recharge for about 180 days; verify the new expiry shown after each recharge before relying on it for account recovery.
Treat historical overseas SMS/OTP reports as operational signals only. Keep roaming data disabled unless needed because MySIM roaming data can trigger a HK$15 daily charge.
